thread:
maya: Quick heads up — onboarding edge case for Sanjay (candidate). Start date currently set to Mon 2026-03-01 but his OPT EAD expires 2026-02-28 and H‑1 COS start is 2026-03-15. Potential authorization gap. Can immigration/payroll advise re: I-9, benefits, and payroll timing?

anna: We need to confirm current authorization on any official start date. If EAD ends 2/28 and he has no new authorization on 3/1, he cannot lawfully work. We CANNOT backdate or fudge I-9. Options: delay start until authorization, unpaid LOA during gap, or remote preboarding that doesn't constitute work.

maya: OK — would an unpaid LOA be workable from payroll perspective? Also needs benefits enrollment handled. @payroll

payroll: Unpaid LOA is feasible. Benefits would be paused after LOA starts; employee can elect COBRA/continuation where eligible. Payroll needs a signed benefits-waiver or LOA effective date. Also need to delay first pay run until authorization is verified. Please send docs to payroll@redwood.com.

leo: IT: if start delayed, we can hold laptop shipment. If they want view-only access to docs (not company systems), we can provide that before auth. No VPN/active accounts until cleared.

sanjay: I prefer to keep the start date if possible — worried about lease and travel. Is there any short-term bridge (e.g., temp contractor)?

anna: Contractor route is not an option if authorization lapses — they must be authorized to be paid for services. If he remains in the US without work authorization after EAD, we can't employ or pay him. 

maya: Action items I propose:
1) People Ops to offer either a) new official start date after confirmed auth, or b) unpaid LOA covering the gap + benefits waiver.
2) Sanjay to provide current EAD, passport, I-94, and any USCIS notices (receipt numbers).
3) Immigration (Anna) to confirm if there's a receipt/expedite that would allow the original date.
4) Payroll to prepare waiver template and hold first payroll.
5) IT to pause equipment until final start date.

maya: Docs list (please upload to candidate folder):
```
- Passport (photo page)
- Current EAD card (front/back)
- I-94 record
- Any USCIS receipt or approval notices (H-1 receipt if filed)
- Signed benefits waiver (if gap)
```

payroll: Waiver template here: https://redwood.internal/waivers/benefits-gap (internal) — send completed PDF back to payroll@redwood.com.

anna: Update: we just received a USCIS receipt WAC-26-9876543 for the COS. Timeline estimate 6–10 weeks; cannot rely on adjudication before 3/1. Recommend candidate assume earliest realistic start after evidence of authorization or plan for LOA.

jess: Benefits note from benefits team: if coverage lapses due to unpaid LOA, employee may elect COBRA. We can provide a cost estimate and short-term resources; Jess will DM Sanjay the numbers.

sanjay: Hearing that timeline, I'd prefer to delay official start to avoid complications. Can we set tentative start to 2026-03-16 and re-evaluate if receipt turns into approval earlier? Also can we keep medical coverage options in the meantime?

maya: Cool — I'll propose 2026-03-16 as the tentative start and send the benefits waiver for the gap coverage decision. We'll reconfirm once Immigration posts an update. Thanks everyone, will update candidate and close the loop. :pray:

anna: Please cc immigration@lawfirm when you send docs — we'll track receipt notice and notify People Ops as soon as status changes.

payroll: Noted. I'll block payroll runs for Sanjay until we get final start date. :thumbsup:

leo: IT will hold devices and provisioning. Let us know if he needs temporary view-only access to handbook or training slides.

maya: End — will follow up with candidate message draft and next steps.
